title: 88Vape Any Tank Strawberry Watermelon & Kiwi 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Watermelon & Kiwi from 88Vape is a sumptuous blend of three fabulous fruit flavours. Juicy, sweet, sun-ripened Strawberries collide with the vibrant, tropical tang of Kiwifruit and Watermelon for a bold and uplifting flavour with an exquisitely smooth and fruity aftertaste. This e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their 50/50 e-liquids are suitable for most kinds of vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss.
